items.t: Grids — Fixed an issue where the month label was off-center in a grid filter's date picker.
App Permissions — Enforced Field Crew (Lite) role restrictions on app access and permission levels.
Preferences/Feature Flags — Removed retired Xero Notifications and Sync Widget flags from stored account preferences and analytics.
LegacyBre — Refactored the legacy business rule engine's SQL access into an async repository layer with no functional change.
Method AI — Fixed an issue where Method AI silently substituted a grid instead of directing users to App Builder.
Kanban Board — Enhanced Kanban board accessibility with screen reader column counts and keyboard-accessible tooltips for truncated values.
Kanban Board — Improved Kanban board mobile card dragging with column-by-column paging, faster drop settling, and sticky column headers.

excluded.reason: one-off data-repair script for a single customer's account (no code change or general deployment) — not customer release-note material
